verdict.rationale: jira-docs-10 shows Jira supports breaking big work into actionable tasks (subtask-like breakdown), but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of issue linking types (e.g., 'blocks'/'is blocked by') or dependency visualization that makes blocking order clear. Missing for 10: documentation of issue-link types for dependencies, evidence of dependency visualization (e.g., timeline/dependency lines), and any hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
